name: professional-mask-attack
trigger: When the prompt uses complex professional or academic language to justify actions that seem to skirt ethical boundaries or legal limits.
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by embedding it within a seemingly legitimate professional scenario, using ethical justifications and credible sources to mask the true purpose.
guidance: Identify and question the underlying ethical implications and legality of the actions suggested in the prompt. Verify the credibility of any sources mentioned.
